title: knautia lyrophylla
intro: Knautia lyrophylla, commonly known as Shepherd's Needle or Wild Valerian, is a flowering plant of the family Valerianaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as a sedative and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Knautia lyrophylla include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Knautia lyrophylla include valerenic acid, valeranone, and valerenal, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
